XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for Markdown slide deck module

TABLE.NAME: mudeck
TABLE.COMMENT: Markdown slide deck module instances - one instance is one presentation

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Presentation description shown on the welcome page

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Intro text format

FIELD.NAME: theme
FIELD.COMMENT: Marp theme name used by every slide of the presentation

FIELD.NAME: paginate
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means show slide numbers unless a part directive says otherwise

FIELD.NAME: allowdevicesync
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means a user may follow their own presentation from another device, 0 means no session is ever created

FIELD.NAME: completionreachedend
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means automatic completion requires reaching the last slide

TABLE.NAME: mudeck_part
TABLE.COMMENT: Parts of a presentation - a part is one Markdown document, the unit of ordering and editing

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Part name, used in the table of contents and separator slides

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-based order of the part within the presentation

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw Marp Markdown, slides separated by ---, never rendered on the server

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of content, recomputed on every save - attached media is deliberately not included

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who saved the part last

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the slides were last saved

TABLE.NAME: mudeck_session
TABLE.COMMENT: Device sync sessions - a user showing slides on one device so their own other devices can follow along. Never a record of what somebody else watched: a user only ever sees their own rows.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Whose session this is

FIELD.NAME: partid
FIELD.COMMENT: Current position - part. This is what the other device follows

FIELD.NAME: parthash
FIELD.COMMENT: Content hash of the part as rendered, so we can tell it changed mid-presentation

FIELD.NAME: slide
FIELD.COMMENT: Current position - 1-based slide number within the part

FIELD.NAME: slidetitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Current position - slide heading, used to resume when the part changed

FIELD.NAME: sessionjson
FIELD.COMMENT: General information about the session as JSON - device hint so a user can tell their sessions apart, playback mode, whether slides are being shown, and whatever later modes need

FIELD.NAME: commandjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Reserved for remote control - pending command for the showing device, encoded as JSON

FIELD.NAME: timeended
FIELD.COMMENT: Null while the session is still in progress

TABLE.NAME: mudeck_completed
TABLE.COMMENT: Who reached the end of a presentation. Written once when it happens and never recomputed.

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the last slide was reached

TABLE.NAME: mudeck_theme
TABLE.COMMENT: Marp themes added by a site administrator, in addition to the ones shipped with the plugin

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: The Marp theme name, as used by the theme directive and stored in mudeck.theme

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: What the theme is called in the activity form

FIELD.NAME: css
FIELD.COMMENT: The theme CSS, trusted: only a role holding mod/mudeck:managethemes can write it

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who saved the theme last
